name: Yuuki Natsumi
source:
Real name: [spoiler]結城 七海 Yuuki Natsumi[/spoiler]
Likes: solitude, black tea, ohagi
Skill: drawing illustrations
Role: illustrator

A new-style designer who lives in the office of Judgement 7. Although she has a sharp tongue and is sometimes strict with others, she is also strict with herself and always works seriously. She will be happy as long as she just gets to draw, and as such she is responsible for character designs, art direction, user interfaces, logos, and all other graphics in Judgement 7's games.

[Translated from [url=http://oreowa.jp/character/natsumi.html]the official site[/url]]
